notes.title: New update with bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi, it's me again, after so long since the last time I updated[i][b] Night and Day[/b][/i].

First of all, let me apologize for the unreasonable delay in fixing the bugs: I suppose many of you know that my team is basically just myself, plus the amazing artists and composers I commission. I sometimes have a bit of help with the coding, but there isn't any regular programmer on my team,  just consultants. The thing is, I've been playtesting the game again and again for [b]the last year and a half[/b], but my poor spaghetti code seems to be confusing Renpy and, even though my consultants and I couldn't find any bugs, they still appeared every time I pushed a new build of the game -_-  

That's the reason the launch of the game was delayed for a year. I give you all my word that I'll never try to make a stats-raising game again, and even less a stats-raising hybrid like [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i]: from now on, my games will be classic visual novels, with affection points and perhaps some minigames, but that's all. I don't want to spend months of my life chasing bugs ever again!

That said, the error in [b]Ferdinand's route[/b] that affected the last two weeks of the game (that is, from the moment Paul decides to give himself a deadline of two weeks) [b]is now fixed[/b].

For the rest of the bugs reported... I haven't been able to reproduce them, but I'll keep going over them. If you want to send a save with your error to my email (ertal77@hotmail.com) that would be really, really useful, but of course it's up to you, and I promise to keep working on making [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i] the best possible BL visual novel it can be.

With love,

Ertal

notes.title: Changelog for version 1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year's Eve!!

Here's the update I promised, right before the end of the year! I hope all those pesky bugs are now fixed: I'll open a post here on the Steam page, where you can send any other thing you find that needs to be fixed (although let's cross our fingers so that isn't necessary).

I'm not sure if this new version will be compatible with your saves; it should be, but anyway, if you previously found errors in your gameplay, it would be advisable to uninstall the previous version and delete the folder on C/: user/AppData/Roaming/Renpy/NightandDay, before installing the new version 1.2. Remember you can use the "Skip" option to progress quickly to your previous point in the game in case you need to start anew.

Changelog:

- The Open Dyslexic font has been adjusted to the right size so the text always fits the textbox.

- The "return" button on the close-up images of the gallery has been moved to the bottom right corner and simplified to just black letters without a background, so it doesn't distract from the images.

- Added an in-game warning when there are only two weeks left to finish the game (as Paul's internal monologue, to be as little intrusive as possible).

- Removed a potentially offensive sentence.

- Added a short afterscene for Emile's intimate scene.

- Checked all the instances where Ferdinand's route might have inconsistencies after March 9.

- Made the dates screen disappear if the player decides not to select anything.

- Lowered two points in the requirements to successfully join the exhibition.

- Added extra days, April 4th to 9th, so the players have more days to go on dates, give presents, and get all the scenes with the love interest that lead to the good ending.

- Added three minigames.

I think that's all! As you can see, I haven't been idle this past month XDD

notes.title: Updated, Extended Demo Available!
notes.content:
While we are making quick progress towards the final release of Night and Day, I think it's time to update the demo and let everyone get a bit more of Paul's story!

[h3]So, what's new in this extended demo:[/h3]

[list]
[*] All the art is finished; that means you'll find five CGs and that all the characters who matter have a face.
[*] 24.5k words.
[*] The first whole week of Paul in Paris: more scenes with Emile, Gilles, and Ferdinand! (Bernard, sadly, only appears a bit later on.) Let's go on dates!
[*] Finished soundtrack.
[*] First skippable mini-game.
[/list]

The text and, especially, some visuals, might change in the final release, depending on your feedback. I would really appreciate it if you could take two minutes to fill in our [b]feedback questionnaire[/b]:
[url=https://forms.gle/GU5SRFrE9yavnf938]https://forms.gle/GU5SRFrE9yavnf938[/url]

Looking forward to hearing what you think, guys!
